nodes.label: Input: nums1 (arg0), nums2 (arg1), x (arg2); s = sum(nums1), d = sum(nums2)
nodes.action: ctx['nums1'] = ctx['arg0']; ctx['nums2'] = ctx['arg1']; ctx['x'] = ctx['arg2']; ctx['n'] = len(ctx['nums1']); ctx['s'] = sum(ctx['nums1']); ctx['d'] = sum(ctx['nums2'])

nodes.label: Sort pairs (nums2[i], nums1[i]) ascending by nums2; DP: dp[j] = max reduction using j zero-operations, where the j-th zeroed element saves nums1[i] + j*nums2[i]; then find the smallest t with s + t*d - dp[t] <= x
